decisions.purpose: Gate warehouse receive search path live test.
decisions.architecture_relevance: Prevents live Supabase dependency from becoming accidental unit-test failure.

decisions.security_impact: positive: avoids leaking or requiring live credentials in normal test runs.
decisions.rationale: The current credential discipline is equivalent and safer than a single env flag.

decisions.purpose: Gate warehouse receive live test on env.

decisions.security_impact: positive: avoids mandatory live credential use in local/CI unit gates.
decisions.rationale: Existing test discipline covers the same risk without adding another env gate.
